why: Both posts and the crossbar are now visible, but the whole gate sits in the left portion of frame with a lot of open glass-wall space to its right -- I am aimed to the right of its center. The proposed move turns right another 39 deg, which would swing the aim further away from the gate, not toward it. Overriding: turn left ~25 deg to bring the gate toward frame-center and close a modest 0.5m, saving the actual crossing for a squared-on look next.
